headline: The CIA secretly dosed Americans with LSD for 20 years. Then it destroyed the files.
slides: The program was called MKUltra. It was approved in 1953 and ran until 1973. The goal: find out whether drugs could control a human mind.
The research ran through more than 80 institutions: universities, hospitals, prisons, drug companies. Many never knew the CIA was paying.
People were given LSD without being told. That included US and Canadian citizens who had no idea they were part of an experiment.
An Army scientist had his drink spiked with LSD at a CIA retreat in 1953. Ten days later he fell from a 10th-floor hotel window in New York.
CIA director Richard Helms ordered every MKUltra file destroyed.
He missed some. In 1977 a Freedom of Information request turned up about 20,000 surviving documents. The Senate held hearings that year.
sources: Sources: Church Committee (1975), US Senate MKUltra hearing (Aug 3 1977), National Security Archive
